units.source_text: 源氏公子虽说贺年，但所到的地方不多：

en.t: Although Prince Genji went to offer New Year greetings, he did not visit many places:

units.source_text: 除了清凉殿（父皇）、东宫（皇兄）、一院（祖父皇）之外，但赴三条院参拜藤壶妃子。

en.t: Apart from the Seiryoden, where his imperial father was, the Crown Prince's quarters, where his elder brother was, and the First Retired Emperor's palace, where his imperial grandfather was, he went only to Sanjo Palace to pay his respects to Lady Fujitsubo.

units.source_text: 三条的众侍女见了他都赞叹：“公子今天特别漂亮呢！

en.t: When the ladies-in-waiting at Sanjo saw him, they all exclaimed, "The prince is especially beautiful today!

units.source_text: 真奇怪，这个人长得一年标致一年了！”

en.t: How strange, this person grows more handsome with every passing year!"

units.source_text: 藤壶妃子隔帘隐约窥见，胸中无限思量！

en.t: Lady Fujitsubo caught a faint glimpse of him through the curtain, and countless thoughts filled her heart.
